_readme: A deliberately small, structured slice of a real Shopware B2B catalogue (the source shop),
collected 2026-09-11 for two questions the generated catalogues cannot ask.
AMBIGUITY: 72 products are tyres, 24 in each of three vehicle worlds — car, motorcycle,
bicycle. 'Reifen' therefore matches across all three, which is the shape a shopper's
unqualified question runs into. The vehicle world is the FIRST element of categoryPath.
DOCUMENTS: 21 motorcycle batteries carry real attached PDFs, up to eleven per product,
because tyres almost never carry one. Several are the same datasheet in eight languages.
PRICES AND STOCK ARE INVENTED. This shop shows prices only to logged-in dealers, so
nothing here was scraped; both are derived from the product number and are meaningless.
Names, category paths are real; document URLs are placeholders.
IDS ARE PREFIXED 'pt-'. A bare parts product number is a numeric string, which PHP coerces
to an int when used as an array key — FactRenderer::retrievedIds() then returns ints and
GroundingOutputProcessor crashes on str_contains(). Real Shopware ids are 32-char hex.
